declaration: This protocol was written before any candidate model was fitted. No hyperparameter, feature, fold or threshold may be changed after seeing candidate results; if a gate fails the honest outcome is 'do not adopt'.
revision: 2 (task-15): the comparison baseline was switched to the leak-free strictly nested calibration of task-12; the pre-fix 0.4622337899166068 baseline used cross-fold calibration features and is voided. Folds, seeds, candidates, metrics and bootstrap are unchanged from revision 1.

leak_fix.audit: docs/审查问题清单_46ca932_20261027.md item 1; fixed in task-12
leak_fix.old_baseline_path: fold_style_mean + calibrate_panel_mean on the whole OOF table (outer-validation labels reach the calibration through other folds' features and whole-table statistics)
leak_fix.new_baseline_path: per outer fold: refit the official raw-panel model on the outer-training beers only, build two inner folds of those beers, and fit the per-target style mean and linear calibrator on those inner OOF cells; then predict the outer-validation fold
leak_fix.reproduction: src/beer_models/q1_decision.fit_nested_linear/apply_nested_linear; the script must reproduce 0.46607189992522735 (style+linear) and 0.5054899408175908 (linear only) at 1e-9 before scoring any candidate
leak_fix.perturbation: changing a validation-fold truth by +0.25 leaves every nested calibration prediction unchanged (task-12 verification: max|delta| = 0.0)

question: Can a model trained directly on the panel-weighted mean (beer x target, 0-6 scale) beat the leak-free nested post-hoc calibration baseline (0.466072 panel-mean OOF MAE) significantly enough to adopt?

truth_definition.panel_weighted_mean: sum_k k * P(grade=k) over the weighted original 0-6 rating distribution of the beer x target panel (same weights as q1_decision_20261028: equal per beer, equal per taster within beer, repeated presentations share the taster weight).
truth_definition.panel_weighted_median: lower weighted median of the same distribution.
truth_definition.targets: the 50 targets with raw panel labels; the two acetaldehyde slots stay excluded, as in the official Q1 delivery

folds.scheme: frozen official Q1 folds, one outer_fold per beer from outputs/r2_raw_q1_20261026/rating_weights_and_folds.csv (style-stratified, outer_seed 20261024, 3 folds)
folds.repeat_definition: the three model seeds of the formal repeated-validation protocol (task5): repeat r uses model seed 20261026 + r*1000 + outer_fold*100 + 99 for the outer-training fit; folds are held fixed so all repeats and the baseline are paired cell by cell
folds.inner_use: fixed hyperparameters from configs/final_protocol.json -> inner folds are audit only (inner-OOF MAE), never used for selection

features.matrix: 1.csv numeric columns minus the 7 excluded derived fields of configs/r2_raw_panel_protocol_20261026.json = 224 predictors
features.preprocessing: median imputation and RobustAsinh fitted on the outer-training beers only (inside the scikit-learn pipeline), same as beer_models.baseline.make_pipeline

baseline_et_posthoc.role: reference, not a candidate for adoption
baseline_et_posthoc.definition: official Extra Trees OOF integer conditional median (r2_raw_q1, method=extra_trees, predicted_grade) mapped to the panel-mean scale by the strictly nested fold-wise per-target linear calibration with a fold-wise style-mean covariate: per outer fold the calibrator and the style means are fitted only on inner OOF cells of that fold's outer-training beers (task-12 audit fix). Equal to 0.46607189992522735.
baseline_et_posthoc.retraining: the inner-fold raw-panel models are refitted inside each outer-training set for the calibration only; the official OOF integer-grade model is untouched

reported_baseline.name: ET integer median + leak-free nested fold-wise style+linear calibration
reported_baseline.source: outputs/q1_decision_20261028/summary.json calibration rows 'nested fold-wise style mean, linear calibration -> panel mean' and 'nested fold-wise linear calibration -> panel mean'
reported_baseline.reproduction_check: the script must reproduce all three values from the frozen inputs at 1e-9 (/1e-12 for the rate) before any candidate is scored

voided_pre_fix.reason: computed with cross-fold calibration features (docs/审查问题清单_46ca932_20261027.md item 1)

metrics.primary: OOF beer-level panel-mean MAE = mean(|panel_mean_pred - panel_mean_reference|) over 250 beers x 50 targets
secondary: round(pred) clipped to 0..6 vs panel-weighted median: exact rate and within-one rate
macro Spearman across the 50 targets between panel_mean_pred and panel_mean_reference
Pearson correlation of panel_mean_pred with the frozen official calibrated panel-mean column outputs/q1_decision_20261028/q1__calibrated_panel_mean_12500.csv:panel_mean_calibrated
per-repeat MAE (repeat 0/1/2) and the pooled 3-repeat mean MAE
audit only: inner-OOF MAE of the primary candidate (2 inner folds x 3 outer folds x 3 seeds)
metrics.rounding: grade_round_pred = clip(rint(panel_mean_pred), 0, 6); rint uses banker's rounding (ties to even), declared and deterministic

uncertainty.method: paired beer bootstrap, 1000 draws, beers resampled within tasting style, seed 20261026
uncertainty.statistic: mean over the 3 repeats of each beer's (baseline absolute error - candidate absolute error) averaged over its 50 targets; positive = candidate better
uncertainty.interval: 2.5% and 97.5% percentiles of the bootstrap distribution of the mean statistic
uncertainty.not_claimed: fixed-fold resampling only; it is not a full-refit confidence interval and not an independent external validation

adoption_gates.gate_3_every_repeat: for each of the 3 repeats, panel-mean MAE < 0.46607189992522735
adoption_gates.gate_4_within_one: pooled round(panel_mean_pred) vs panel-weighted median within-one rate >= 0.9119 (absolute pre-registered floor: the current official integer-grade within-one 0.9169 minus 0.5 percentage point; unchanged by the task-15 baseline correction)
adoption_gates.gate_4_note: the delta against the leak-free nested calibration baseline (0.91416) is reported as a diagnostic only; re-anchoring the floor to that baseline would be a post-hoc loosening and is not used

constraints.scope: post-development reuse of the same 250 beers; fixed-fold bootstrap; not external validation
